introduction_markdown:
This paper is arranged in three sections, A, B and C. Section A: answer ALL 5 questions; you will be graded for the best 4 answers. Section B: answer ALL 2 questions in this section. Section C: answer 2 questions out of 3; if you attempt more than 2 questions, only the first two will be considered. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

**Useful data:** relative atomic masses H = 1.0, C = 12.0, O = 16.0, N = 14.0; 1 faraday = 96000 coulombs; molar volume of a gas at r.t.p. = 24000 cm$^3$; specific heat capacity of water = 4.2 J g$^{-1}$ $^\circ$C$^{-1}$; Avogadro number = $6.02\times10^{23}$; $0^\circ$C = 273 K.
incertitudes: Points imprimés 2 + 5 + 2 + 1 = 10, conformes au total. 3(b)(i) : le dessin des deux isomères est demandé à l'élève ; ils sont décrits dans le corrigé (butane et 2-méthylpropane), aucune figure produite.

En-tête de la Section A : « ANSWER ALL 5 questions. You will be graded for the best 4 answers » ; modélisé en « 4 sur 5 » (toutes tentées, 4 meilleures notées). Section B : « ANSWER ALL 2 questions » modélisé en « 2 sur 2 ». Section C : « ANSWER 2 QUESTIONS OUT OF 3 » (si plus de 2 tentées, seules les deux premières comptent) ; modélisé en « 2 sur 3 ».

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) Write the general formula of the homologous series to which the compound belongs. .........

(ii) Name the homologous series to which the compound belongs ......... *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) General formula: **$\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$**. Check: $n = 4$ gives $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$.

(ii) The **alkanes** (saturated hydrocarbons, only single C-C bonds).

questions.enonce_markdown:
$\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$ exist in more than one structural form.

(i) Draw and name two structural forms of the compound

(ii) What name is given to the structural forms? ......... *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) *What to draw (full structural formulas, each carbon with four bonds and each hydrogen with one bond):*

1. **Butane** (straight chain of four carbon atoms): $\mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3}$. Displayed: $\mathrm{H_3C}$ at each end, with two $\mathrm{CH_2}$ groups between them, all C-C and C-H bonds drawn.
2. **2-methylpropane** (branched chain): a chain of three carbon atoms with a $\mathrm{CH_3}$ branch on the middle carbon, $\mathrm{CH_3-CH(CH_3)-CH_3}$.

Both have the formula $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$ (4 C atoms and 10 H atoms).

(ii) They are **structural isomers** (the property is called isomerism): same molecular formula, different structural formulas.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write a balanced equation for the combustion of $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$ ......... *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Complete combustion in excess oxygen gives carbon dioxide and water:

$2\mathrm{C_4H_{10}(g)} + 13\mathrm{O_2(g)} \rightarrow 8\mathrm{CO_2(g)} + 10\mathrm{H_2O(l)}$

Check: C: $2 \times 4 = 8$; H: $2 \times 10 = 20 = 10 \times 2$; O: $13 \times 2 = 26 = 8 \times 2 + 10$.

(Equivalent: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}} + \tfrac{13}{2}\mathrm{O_2} \rightarrow 4\mathrm{CO_2} + 5\mathrm{H_2O}$.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Give one domestic use of $\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$ ......... *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: It is used as a **fuel for cooking** (cooking gas, LPG: butane in gas cylinders) or in gas lighters.
